channel.title: CannActuality — Research Briefs
channel.description: Sourced, dated cannabis research briefs for licensed vendors and product teams — consumer and category trends, category deep-dives, and regulatory watch.

item.title: The December 11 Readiness Brief: Converting Hemp SKUs to Licensed Channels
item.description: A state-by-state checklist, California first, for moving intoxicating hemp SKUs into licensed cannabis channels before the federal hemp redefinition lands on December 11, 2026.

item.title: Vape Category Teardown 2026: Hardware, Flavor Systems, and the Disposables Question
item.description: Disposables now hold a majority of US vape dollars, live resin is taking share from distillate, and flavor and disposal rules decide which vape formats a state will allow.

item.title: Edibles After the Beverage Boom: Gummies, Ratios, Fast-Acting, and the Pack Ladder
item.description: California edibles fell 3.8% in April 2026 and rose 10% by October. Growth sits in ratio gummies, fast-acting niches and clear pack tiers, not THC-only basics.

item.title: Medical-Channel Economics After Schedule III: What DEA Registration Changes for Product Teams
item.description: DEA registration for state medical licensees is live, a November 29 supply-chain deadline looms, and § 280E relief is promised but not yet in formal guidance.

item.title: New-State Market Entry 2026–2027: Reading Maturity Before Capital
item.description: A sourced scoring rubric for six adult-use states on category mix, price compression and retail density, plus caps, taxes and timelines for Virginia and Pennsylvania.

item.title: Terpene Preservation: Packaging, Storage, and Shelf Life
item.description: How light, oxygen, temperature, and packaging materials degrade terpenes — and what product teams can specify to slow it.

item.title: Post-Harvest Science: Drying, Curing, and Water Activity
item.description: Drying curves, cure conditions, and water-activity targets — where finished-product quality is won or lost after harvest.

item.title: Nutrient Programs and Mineral Nutrition: What the Evidence Supports
item.description: NPK regimes, EC and pH management, and fertigation strategy — what controlled studies actually show about yield and chemotype outcomes.

item.title: Lighting Science for Cultivation: Spectrum, Intensity, and Product Consistency
item.description: How spectrum, DLI, and photoperiod decisions in the grow room show up downstream as cannabinoid and terpene consistency in finished products.

item.title: Minor Cannabinoids in Product Development: CBN, CBG, THCV and the 2026 Formulation Map
item.description: CBN, CBG and THCV now appear mainly as ratio partners in gummies, tablets and softgels. BDSA, Headset and 2026 launch data map where each cannabinoid shows up, and the November-December 2026 federal hemp dates redraw hemp-derived supply.

item.title: Pre-roll Architecture 2026: Singles, Multi-Packs, and the Infused Tier
item.description: Pre-rolls are America's top category by units. BDSA and Headset data show the 1-gram single still anchors volume, 0.5-gram five-packs drive growth, and infused has crossed half of category dollars — how to build the pack ladder.

item.title: 2026 Consumer Trends: A Mature Market Rewards Convenience and Value
item.description: California tracked cannabis sales fell 7.1% year over year in April 2026 while pre-rolls became the top US category by units. A sourced CannActuality brief on where demand is moving and what product teams should build.

item.title: Regulatory Watch: Two Federal Clocks and California's Hemp Integration
item.description: As of October 29, 2026: state-licensed medical marijuana is Schedule III under DEA's April 2026 final order; broad rescheduling is stayed; the federal hemp redefinition takes effect November 12 and December 11, 2026; California's AB 8 integration is underway. A dated, sourced CannActuality brief for product teams.

item.title: THC Beverages: The Dose Moved, the Channel Moved, the Clock Is Ticking
item.description: Convenience-store hemp THC beverage sales grew 74% year over year (NielsenIQ, 2026 NACS Show) and 10 mg became the leading strength. A sourced CannActuality deep-dive on beverage product development — and the December 11, 2026 federal hemp deadline.
